items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-10 implemented and each pinned by a test; the spec reviewer's three divergences (console names both invocations, full-run reasons always printed, AC-10 probe strength) were fixed and re-reviewed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: prepare_resume and persist never raise (fail closed = full run); every refusal branch has a reason string and a test; save_state failure keeps the previous state and leaves no stray pointer.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets; state is local-only; CURRENT pins the manifest hash, pointer containment is resolved against the store, every opened path must be hash-verified, provenance_extra cannot override run_id/head_commit/reports.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real pytest + real git fix round asserts executions via marker files, merged whole-unit total, purged stale coverage line, spent token; fake-exec tests cover every refusal; equal-count/different-identity and edited-test-file cases pinned.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra whole-tree hash per F0 (disclosed, unmeasured); a gate-refused resume costs one extra full run (disclosed, one-shot, recorded as resume_fallback).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Four new modules each < 300 lines, ResumeOps seam mirrors RetryOps, run_test_suite.py stays at 523 <= 529, F0.md back at its 400-line cap.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Four producer/consumer pairs (state save/load, coverage sqlite restore, lastfailed cache, manifest resumed marker) each round-tripped through real files; the real-pytest test reads the sqlite coverage that pytest-cov wrote.
